title: The Golden Pheasant on 58th Street
summary: She went to the Golden Pheasant after the Panama; she recalls a few performers and possibly Almond Ellison's band.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Uh, after Panama, where did, where did you go?
Oh, after Panama, I went to, there was another nightclub in the 200 block on 58th street called the Golden Pheasant.
Then? Do you remember anybody there? I can remember Bill Thrillkill and Chick Bailey, she's a girl she's passed on to. Was she also a singer?
Yes, she was a singer. What did Thrillkill do?
He was a singer. Well, I can't remember who all was there.

Let's see who had the orchestra there. I think, uh... Almond Ellison, I think. His passed too. Almond Ellison. I think, I think he had it then. But it's been so long, you know, things have, you know, just...
We'll try to locate because maybe they advertised in the Defender someplace, did they? And we could go hunting through those files.

Yes, I, that's what I was looking for that book. I thought it was, I thought it was up front, but I got it put away someplace. I don't know where it is. I'll, I'll have it sometime, maybe next time you're around any place, you know, that I know you're gonna be somewhere. I'll find it and bring it maybe. And, uh, then from there I went to, uh, Clefter Lisa.
